# CHANGES — CLI + manual fixtures + real-IDL inspect scaffold

## Confirmations
- manual-test.sh: **14/14 pairs behaved as expected** (incl. 16_collision, 17_disc_reencoded)
- clippy pedantic: clean
- hand runs: field_widen exit=1, enum_append exit=0, broken_json exit=2, collision exit=1
- No expected-FAIL pairs (collision + encoding-normalization features are present)
- convert_type has no catch-all; Map/Set/Tuple/Struct/Enum + F32/F64/ShortU16 stay Generic by design / known gap

## Codama TypeNode variants still mapping to Type::Generic
- **Map / Set** — associative; not positional Borsh scalars we field-diff. Opaque by design.
- **Tuple / Struct / Enum (inline as field type)** — no Defined name without inventing synthetic ids; top-level account/definedTypes are promoted separately. Known gap for rare anonymous inlines; Vixen fixtures usually Link.
- **NumberFormat F32 / F64 / ShortU16** — not modeled Anchor/Borsh integer scalars. Opaque by design.

## What this delivery covers
- PART A: `diff` + `inspect` CLI (clap, owo-colors TTY-only, --json view struct, exit 0/1/2)
- PART B: fixtures/manual/ pairs 00–03, 10–17, 90–91
- PART C: fixtures/real/README.md + convert_type audit
- PART D: scripts/manual-test.sh + scripts/inspect-real.sh
